note: Indicative market rates for Tamil Nadu (compiled from public market references, Sep 2026). Verify live rates with your dealer before ordering.

materials.name: Cement OPC 53 Grade
materials.specs: Conforms to IS 269:2015. Higher early strength than PPC; sets faster.
materials.uses: RCC columns, beams, slabs, precast elements and structures needing fast strength gain.

materials.name: Cement PPC (Blended)
materials.specs: Fly-ash blended, conforms to IS 1489 Part 1. Denser, lower heat of hydration.
materials.uses: Masonry, plastering and general construction; better durability in coastal areas.

materials.name: White Cement
materials.specs: White Portland cement for finishes; high whiteness index.
materials.uses: Wall putty mixing, grouting, tile joints and decorative finishes.

materials.name: Ready-Mix Concrete M25
materials.gst_note: Usually excl. GST; pumping charged extra. Minimum 3 m³ load.
materials.specs: Design mix as per IS 456; slump and grade certified at plant.
materials.uses: RCC slabs, columns and footings where site mixing is impractical.

materials.name: TMT Steel Bar Fe500D
materials.gst_note: Usually excl. 18% GST; rate varies by bar diameter (8–32 mm)
materials.specs: IS 1786:2008. 'D' = higher ductility — recommended for seismic Zone III (most of TN). CRS variant (+8–12%) for coastal plots (OMR, ECR).
materials.uses: Main reinforcement for residential RCC — footings, columns, beams, slabs.

materials.name: TMT Steel Bar Fe550D
materials.specs: IS 1786:2008. Higher yield strength; thinner sections carry the same load.
materials.uses: High-rise and heavy-load structures; saves steel tonnage in designed projects.

materials.name: Binding Wire (GI)
materials.specs: 18–20 gauge annealed GI wire. Rule of thumb: ~1 kg needed per 100 kg of TMT steel.
materials.uses: Tying rebar cages at intersections before concreting.

materials.name: M-Sand (Concrete Grade)
materials.specs: Manufactured sand, IS 383 Zone II grading. Always ask for the sieve-analysis certificate — low-grade M-sand is common in the unorganised market.
materials.uses: RCC concrete, block work and masonry — the default fine aggregate in TN.
materials.note: TN mining-crackdown (Jun 2026) pushed quarry rates up 20–100%; Trichy & Karur belt rates run higher when quarry supply tightens.

materials.name: P-Sand (Plastering Grade)
materials.specs: Finer than M-sand, IS 383 Zone III grading — smoother plaster finish.
materials.uses: Internal and external wall plastering, finishing coats.

materials.name: River Sand
materials.gst_note: Small delivered loads quoted ~₹120–140 per cft.
materials.specs: Natural sand; supply restricted under TN sand-mining regulations.
materials.uses: Premium plaster finishes where available; most builders have switched to P-sand.
materials.note: Availability is permit-linked and varies by district — always verify the permit.

materials.name: Filling Sand / Red Soil
materials.specs: Non-structural fill material.
materials.uses: Plinth filling, plot levelling and backfilling.

materials.name: Crusher Dust (Quarry Dust)
materials.specs: Byproduct of stone crushing; slightly silty.
materials.uses: Sub-base, paver bedding and low-grade filling.

materials.name: Blue Metal 20 mm (Jelly)
materials.specs: Crushed granite, IS 383 graded coarse aggregate.
materials.uses: RCC slabs and columns — the standard concrete aggregate.

materials.name: Blue Metal 40 mm
materials.specs: Larger gauge aggregate for mass concrete.
materials.uses: PCC bed, foundations, retaining walls and roadwork.

materials.name: Aggregate 12 mm
materials.specs: Medium gauge aggregate.
materials.uses: Thin slabs, flooring base course and second-layer concrete.

materials.name: 6 mm Chips
materials.specs: Small gauge aggregate / grit.
materials.uses: Flooring base, wet mix and terrazzo flooring.

materials.name: Wet Mix / GSB
materials.specs: Plant-mixed granular sub-base material.
materials.uses: Road and compound base courses, hard standings.

materials.name: Red Bricks (Wire-cut)
materials.specs: Table-moulded bricks ₹8–10; wire-cut ₹12–16. Check for uniform ringing sound and straight edges.
materials.uses: Traditional load-bearing and partition walls; needs more mortar than blocks.

materials.name: Fly Ash Bricks
materials.specs: Uniform size, eco-friendly; less mortar consumption than red bricks.
materials.uses: Partition and masonry walls; good plaster adhesion.

materials.name: AAC Blocks (600×200×150 mm)
materials.specs: Autoclaved aerated concrete — about ¼ the weight of red brick walls; better thermal insulation.
materials.uses: Faster wall construction; reduces structural steel load on frames.

materials.name: Solid Concrete Blocks (6")
materials.specs: Vibrated cement-solid blocks, 6-inch profile.
materials.uses: Compound walls, partitions and boundary work.

materials.name: Vitrified Floor Tiles
materials.specs: 600×600 mm double-charge is the sweet spot for homes; full-body tiles cost more but resist scratches.
materials.uses: Living, dining and bedroom flooring.

materials.name: Ceramic Wall Tiles
materials.specs: Glazed ceramic, usually 300×600 mm.
materials.uses: Kitchen and bathroom walls.

materials.name: Granite Slabs
materials.specs: Indian granite; Black Galaxy and premium finishes sit at the top of the range.
materials.uses: Kitchen countertops, stair treads and cladding.

materials.name: Interior Emulsion Paint
materials.specs: Coverage ~110–140 sq ft per litre for 2 coats.
materials.uses: Interior walls; washable/stain-resistant premium emulsions.

materials.name: Exterior Weather Paint
materials.specs: UV- and alkali-resistant elastomeric exterior emulsion.
materials.uses: Exterior facades, boundary walls; guards against monsoon cracking.

materials.name: Wall Primer
materials.specs: Alkali-resistant primer; required under emulsion.
materials.uses: Sealing putty and plaster before top coats.

materials.name: White Cement Putty (40 kg)
materials.specs: Coverage ~20–25 sq ft per kg for 2 coats.
materials.uses: Leveling interior and exterior walls before painting.

materials.name: PVC Electrical Conduit 25 mm
materials.specs: ISI-marked heavy-gauge conduit pipe with coupler.
materials.uses: Concealed electrical wiring in walls and slabs.

materials.name: CPVC Pipe 1/2" SDR-11
materials.specs: Hot-and-cold water rated CPVC, SDR-11 schedule.
materials.uses: Internal water supply lines and terrace connections.

materials.name: FR Electrical Wire 1.5 sq mm
materials.specs: Flame-retardant (FR) copper wire, IS 694.
materials.uses: Light and fan circuits; 2.5 sq mm for power circuits.
